about_the_game:
Jump aboard the pirate ships of the Chinese Pirate Confederation in The Oriental Pirate, a DLC of the turn-based JRPG Banner of the Maid. While on a reconnaissance mission with Lannes, Pauline (protagonist of Banner of the Maid) accidentally boards a British warship. Just as they are about to be discovered by her enemies, a strange shadow figure appears in the cabin and saves her… It’s Mu Zhiyun, a bold pirate serving under the mythical figure of the pirate queen Ching Shish. Following secret orders, Mu Zhiyun will join Pauline and sail across the oceans to Europe. What adventures will she live in the French Revolution?

The Oriental Pirate contains 5 challenge missions, interwoven with the main campaign of Banner of the Maid, a new heroine (Mu Zhiyun) and the Pirates as a new unit that can join your army. Armed with different weapons and unique skills, Mu Zhiyun and her Pirates will leave their footprint on the battlefield!

To enjoy the content of this DLC, accept the mission “The Oriental Pirate” in the Salon and complete it; you will receive these new characters as well as treasures and items. Then, when you finish Chapter 18 of the main campaign you’ll access the new quest line “A Sailor’s Gossip”. Warning: you need Thérèse in your army to unlock Chapter 3 of this storyline!
